claim_summary_zh: Clarivate 表示超过 50 个被标记期刊未通过质量标准并已去索引。
quote_original: Our investigations are ongoing and thus far, more than 50 of the flagged journals have failed our quality criteria and have subsequently been de-listed.
quote_location: section Responding to changes in the publishing landscape
local_alignment: Provides external governance context for early-2023 index actions.
interpretation_limit: This general count is not limited to Hindawi.
title: Supporting Integrity of the Scholarly Record in Web of Science
notes: Official statement on Web of Science re-evaluation and journal de-listing.

claim_summary_zh: Clarivate 本轮去索引期刊中有 19 个 Hindawi 期刊。
quote_original: Among these were 19 Hindawi (owned by Wiley) journals.
quote_location: section The Effect of Paper Mills on Hindawi
local_alignment: Top local batches are concentrated in Hindawi journals.
interpretation_limit: Index removal is not a direct estimate of retraction cause or national misconduct.
title: Guest Post - Addressing Paper Mills and a Way Forward for Journal Security
notes: Authored by Jay Flynn, Executive Vice President and General Manager, Research at Wiley.

claim_summary_zh: Wiley 正在追加撤回约 1,200 篇受损论文。
quote_original: We are currently in the process of retracting an additional estimated 1,200 compromised papers.
quote_location: section How Hindawi Addressed the Problem
local_alignment: Local 2023 Hindawi count is 8,036 of 10,028 main-analysis papers.
interpretation_limit: Later realized retraction counts differ from contemporaneous estimates.
title: Guest Post - Addressing Paper Mills and a Way Forward for Journal Security
notes: Authored by Jay Flynn, Executive Vice President and General Manager, Research at Wiley.

claim_summary_zh: Wiley 说明此前已发出首批 511 篇撤稿。
quote_original: Specifically, we paused publication of Special Issues, alerted other publishers and third-party providers of the presence of bad actors in their systems, increased rigorous new checks throughout our publishing workflows, issued an initial 511 retractions, and introduced additional AI-based screening tools.
quote_location: section How Hindawi Addressed the Problem
local_alignment: Provides the precursor to the later 1,200-paper estimate and 2023 batches.
interpretation_limit: The initial count is not a complete annual total.
title: Guest Post - Addressing Paper Mills and a Way Forward for Journal Security
notes: Authored by Jay Flynn, Executive Vice President and General Manager, Research at Wiley.

claim_summary_zh: 待追加撤回论文集中于既有期刊且全部来自特刊，特刊被论文工厂针对性利用。
quote_original: The Special Issues in these journals were targeted by papermills and bad actors, with researcher identities manipulated (to appear as legitimate researchers) and content fabricated (to appear as legitimate content).
quote_location: publisher spokesperson statement quoted in article
local_alignment: Local publication-process family is 71.02% of the 2023 event sample.
interpretation_limit: A publisher statement describes detected cases; it is not a population prevalence estimate.
verification_note: Independent specialist report quoting a Wiley spokesperson.
title: Wiley and Hindawi to retract 1,200 more papers for compromised peer review
notes: Independent event report that links the Wiley executive commentary and publisher statement.

claim_summary_zh: Hindawi 关闭四个被论文工厂严重侵入的期刊。
quote_original: As we continue to mitigate against systematic manipulation of the publishing process, Hindawi has today closed four journals, which have been heavily compromised by paper mills.
local_alignment: Closure occurred before the largest June-December local batches.
interpretation_limit: Journal closure is a governance response and does not estimate misconduct incidence.
verification_note: Full paragraph observed in archived official page.
title: Evolving our portfolio in response to integrity challenges
notes: Live page returned a security check; archived snapshot contained the full announcement and publication date.

claim_summary_zh: 关闭原因指向受影响的特刊，而不是一般论文数量增长。
quote_original: These journals have published Special Issues that have been impacted to such an extent that we feel it is in the best interest of the scholarly community to discontinue them.
local_alignment: Local 2023 sample has 7,122 publication-process papers, 71.02% of the event sample.
interpretation_limit: Special issues can be affected for multiple reasons; this does not imply all special-issue papers are problematic.
verification_note: Full paragraph observed in archived official page.
title: Evolving our portfolio in response to integrity challenges
notes: Live page returned a security check; archived snapshot contained the full announcement and publication date.

claim_summary_zh: Hindawi 出版暂停使 Wiley Research 季度收入减少约 1,800 万美元。
quote_original: Revenue of $258 million was down 5%, or 7% at constant currency, mainly due to the Hindawi publishing pause (-$18 million)
local_alignment: Supports the scale of publisher disruption, not China-specific incidence.
interpretation_limit: Revenue impact cannot be converted into a misconduct rate.
title: Second Quarter Fiscal 2024 Earnings Release
notes: Official financial report; text extracted with pdftotext.

claim_summary_zh: Wiley 计划停用 Hindawi 品牌并把开放获取期刊整合进 Wiley。
quote_original: Wiley to sunset the Hindawi brand and fully integrate its OA journal portfolio and expertise into the Wiley ecosystem.
local_alignment: Occurs after the 2023 retraction peak and documents governance aftermath.
interpretation_limit: Brand integration does not prove the cause of earlier retraction batches.
title: Second Quarter Fiscal 2024 Earnings Presentation
notes: Official earnings presentation; text extracted with pdftotext.

claim_summary_zh: Wiley CEO 在财报电话会宣布停用 Hindawi 品牌并整合约 200 个期刊。
quote_original: ... we feel that now is the time to sunset the Hindawi brand and begin to fully integrate its 200 journals into Wiley's 2,000 journal portfolio.
interpretation_limit: Corporate restructuring is not an academic-integrity outcome.
verification_note: Independent specialist report linked to official earnings materials.
title: Wiley to stop using Hindawi name amid $18 million revenue decline
notes: Independent report that links the official earnings materials.

claim_summary_zh: Wiley 复盘称需要调查的稿件达到数千篇。
quote_original: These initial investigations coupled with the findings of independent researchers pointed to the infiltration of Hindawi SIs at an even greater scale than first anticipated, making it clear that thousands of manuscripts would need to be investigated.
local_alignment: Matches local concentration of 2023 retractions in Hindawi publication-process cases.
interpretation_limit: The quote is process evidence, not proof that every investigated paper was fraudulent.
verification_note: Official page title/date observed in archived HTML; exact quote cross-checked in S07.
title: Tackling publication manipulation at scale: Hindawi's journey and lessons for academic publishing
notes: Official page metadata shows repository modification date 2023-12-12. Quoted process details are cross-checked in S07.

claim_summary_zh: 2023 年全球研究论文撤稿数量首次超过 10,000 篇。
quote_original: The number of retractions issued for research articles in 2023 has passed 10,000 - smashing annual records
local_alignment: Local China-associated event count is 10,028 papers, but the denominators differ.
interpretation_limit: A global record does not identify China-specific causes or rates.
verification_note: Peer-reviewed news analysis with DOI metadata.
title: More than 10,000 research papers were retracted in 2023 - a new record
notes: Bibliographic metadata and summary observed; DOI 10.1038/d41586-023-03974-8.

claim_summary_zh: 截至 2023 年末，Hindawi 已撤回超过 8,000 篇文章。
quote_original: So far in 2023, Hindawi has retracted over 8,000 articles – more than we’ve ever seen in a single year from all publishers combined.
local_alignment: Local main-analysis 2023 sample contains 8,036 Hindawi papers.
interpretation_limit: Paper counts depend on DOI linkage, notification timing and Retraction Watch updates.
title: Hindawi reveals process for retracting more than 8,000 paper mill articles
notes: Independent specialist reporting that quotes and links the Wiley whitepaper.
